sum: Bhanu Chopra submitted a disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4)–31(5) of the Takeover Regulations 2011 to NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition event in Rategain Travel Technologies Limited. The filing triggers mandatory open offer thresholds and regulatory gate.
detail: Bhanu Chopra filed disclosure with NSE under Regulation 31(4) and 31(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is triggered when a person acquires shares or voting rights in a listed company that cross the 5% threshold or add 2% or more in any financial year, or when a person holding 5% or more acquires additional shares. Rategain Travel Technologies is a Delhi-based SaaS platform specialising in hotel and travel technology solutions. The filing does not disclose the transaction value or exact stake size in the public excerpt, but establishes a regulatory touchpoint for mandatory open offer assessment.
